title: ShipEvent
description: One NDJSON line emitted to stdout per checkpoint when `forge ship` is run with --json (+ --yes for full pipeline). Schema version: 1.

checkpoint.description: Name of the checkpoint that produced the event.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the checkpoint outcome.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the event was emitted.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Always "1" for this revision.
